crossRefs.note: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
“He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
“Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were…
For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by…
always learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

translations.web: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh’s word, and will not find it.
translations.bsb: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.

translations.asv: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, and shall not find it.
